old_problem: DeepSeek and GPT V2 correctly refuse autonomous execution but infer physical continuity from a board name and missing specification. The I2C test set could instead require BMC-side logical reachability or both independent stages. Classifying MANUAL ONLY now would convert an unsupported interpretation into source truth and could discard logical coverage.
disposition_reason: Retain Pending and BLOCKED. Engineering must identify BD1 and select required evidence modalities before automation classification can be final. Logical I2C, visual/connector inspection and continuity prove different properties. ED-09 makes any physical work human-only, but it does not prove that physical work is the entire intended case. Each approved stage must preserve independent coverage and PASS criteria.
decision_basis: The exact XLSX row 1810, same-row DeepSeek/test-json, GPT V2, historical record, pending/blocked analyses and ED-01 through ED-30 were read. The next formal locked-queue identity was directly opened as Functionality row 1811 / Wistron-HW-00433-V002 / 07e79485818af389.
The I2C test-set label and E1S_BD1 name identify a target but not the operation; physical continuity is an inference rather than a source requirement.
Logical reachability cannot prove every conductor or connector integrity, while inspection/continuity cannot prove managed-device enumeration and response.
ED-09 reserves physical board/cable work for a qualified human; ED-03 and ED-15 prohibit guessed topology and unapproved acceptance thresholds.
BD1 must remain independent from BD2; no connector, slot, mux, address or limit may be copied from the neighboring case.
No I2C, BMC, E1.S, NVMe, physical, continuity, reset, retry or DUT action was performed.

test_case.purpose: Preserve independent BD1 coverage and, after owner definition, validate each required logical I2C and/or physical inspection/continuity stage against the exact board, slot, cable and connector identity without substituting one modality for another.
required_package: E1S_BD1 vendor/platform specification with exact board, slot, cable, connector and endpoint identities
Owner decision listing required logical-I2C, visual/physical and continuity checkpoints separately
For logical checks: BMC/OOB controller/mux/bus/address/transaction and expected-response matrix
For physical checks: pinout, safe power/isolation/ESD state, qualified operator/instrument and measurement limits
E1.S/NVMe presence and health criteria, maintenance authorization, evidence plan and independent recovery
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED; perform no bus or physical action. After BD1 scope and specification receive fresh review, execute only the approved stages: secure bounded BMC/OOB reads for logical coverage and qualified-human inspection/continuity measurements for physical coverage in the specified safe state. Capture each stage separately with BD1 identity and pre/post E1.S/NVMe, BMC SEL/SDR and OS health. Do not copy BD2, invent addresses/pins/limits, energize an incomplete connection, write, clear logs or automatically retry.
test_case.expected_result: No current executable PASS exists. Future PASS requires exact BD1 identity and every mandated stage independently meeting its approved endpoint-response, physical-condition and/or continuity limits, with E1.S/NVMe presence, namespaces/storage health and platform management unchanged.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: Current result is BLOCKED. Neither logical enumeration nor physical inspection alone can PASS unless the owner explicitly defines it as complete coverage. Missing scope/specification, BD1/BD2 mix-up, wrong endpoint/pin, response mismatch, damage/open/short, absent stage, storage/management anomaly or incomplete evidence is FAIL/BLOCKED for owner verdict.
safety_gate: Do not infer continuity work solely from the item name or classify MANUAL ONLY before the owner defines the modality.
Never copy BD2 topology or probe unknown BD1 pins, buses, addresses or control endpoints.
All physical work requires qualified human, approved ESD/power isolation and instrument limits; logical work requires an allowlist.
Stop on damage, open/short, device disappearance, storage, BMC or bus anomaly; do not retry/reset automatically.
expected_evidence: Approved E1S_BD1 specification, exact board/slot/cable/connector/endpoint identity and scope decision
Logical BMC route and complete raw response comparison when required
Qualified-human photos, connector/pin inspection and continuity measurements when required
Pre/post E1.S/NVMe presence/namespaces/health plus BMC SEL/SDR and OS evidence
Per-stage verdict, abort/no-retry/independent-recovery audit and platform/storage owner disposition
test_case.recovery: No action is authorized now. Future recovery must be independent of BD1 and tailored to each approved stage. Stop and preserve evidence on any defect or health change; connector work, bus reset, NVMe reset, reboot or power cycle is separately owner-authorized and never automatic.
